title: Shared call
createHelp: Create one task for the call. Each participant gets their own planned time; confirm attendance after the call to record actual time.
name: Call name
fieldHelp: Choose two existing duration fields for the call's planned and actual duration. A 60-minute call counts as 60 minutes for each person who attended.
rosterHelp: Choose everyone expected on the call. This list is separate from task collaborators; adding someone does not confirm attendance.
fullDuration: The planned duration applies to each participant. Attendance can be full, partial or absent.
noAutomaticAttendance: After the call, open this task and choose Confirm attendance.
invalidConfiguration: Review the name, event date, organizer, call participants and two different duration fields.
retry: Retry the original shared activity command
enableHelp: Use this task for a call. Add participants, then confirm attendance to record each person's time.
savedSummary: Duration {{duration}} min · {{count}} current participants · Known team effort {{minutes}} min · {{unknown}} unconfirmed
snapshotHelp: Confirmed time keeps its saved event duration and roster version. Current settings differ; use an explicit correction with a reason to change recorded time.
editDurationHelp: Edit the call duration in the task fields above. Use Confirm attendance to record each person's actual time.
sourceChanged: The source changed after this draft opened. Discard and reopen to review the latest version.
confirmHelp: Select who attended and check their minutes. Present records the full actual duration; Partial lets you enter fewer minutes. Not confirmed stays unknown.
selfOnly: You can confirm your own attendance. Recording other people's time requires permission.
invalidAttendance: Select at least one permitted participant and review partial minutes and any correction reason.
ordinaryUnresolved: Finish or recover the ordinary task save before recording shared activity changes.
addOptionsHelp: Add a shared call or section
